Action Plan:
1. Prescribe inhaler therapy: Salbutamol (Ventolin) and Clenil Modulite (beclomethasone) — prescriptions to be sent to patient (dose/route/frequency not documented).
2. Prescribe oral corticosteroid tablets for acute exacerbation: take two tablets each morning for five days (oral corticosteroid name not documented; route documented by administration instructions; duration documented).
3. Provide a spacer device with usage instructions; advise spacer use to improve inhaler delivery.
4. Instruct patient to use Clenil daily as maintenance and Salbutamol PRN for wheeze; advise seeking medical attention if Salbutamol is needed more frequently than every 3 hours or if symptoms worsen (worsening shortness of breath, chest pain/tightness, light-headedness).
5. Arrange prescriptions to be available promptly (doctor stated within the hour).
6. Advise rest and permit time off work; patient may self-certify for first 7 days.
7. Safety-net: seek urgent medical care for deterioration (increasing breathlessness, chest pain/tightness, light-headedness).
8. Verbal consent from patient has been obtained before using transcription software.
